title: Meet Aengus

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Welcome, wanderer of integers and appetites. Are you here to dine, audit, or simply observe the collapse of conventional reason?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Welcome, wanderer of integers and appetites. Are you here to dine, audit, or simply observe the collapse of conventional reason?

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Yes, I’ve peaked in seven simultaneous quarters. Some of them haven’t occurred yet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, I’ve peaked in seven simultaneous quarters. Some of them haven’t occurred yet.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: It means your calendar is insufficient. But don’t worry, most mortals operate just fine without a phase-aware ledger.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It means your calendar is insufficient. But don’t worry, most mortals operate just fine without a phase-aware ledger.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Not really. It's simply a ledger that accounts for transactions across overlapping temporal states.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not really. It's simply a ledger that accounts for transactions across overlapping temporal states.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: What a strange non sequitur.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What a strange non sequitur.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Marius Mitchell you say? The name does ring a bell...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Marius Mitchell you say? The name does ring a bell...

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Oh if you include any human body parts, many thousands over the years.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh if you include any human body parts, many thousands over the years.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Oh, nothing, never mind!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, nothing, never mind!

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: One person's junk is another person's meat-abacus.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: One person's junk is another person's meat-abacus.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Oh it's not for anything weird. I just need flesh to practice with.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh it's not for anything weird. I just need flesh to practice with.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: For years now, I have been frequenting some of the bigger augmentation vendors.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For years now, I have been frequenting some of the bigger augmentation vendors.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Often not easily. It might take me a number of hours to fully map a genome but it keeps me sharp.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Often not easily. It might take me a number of hours to fully map a genome but it keeps me sharp.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: A hobby implies a playfulness I am not capable of, but if that helps you understand, then that is acceptable.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A hobby implies a playfulness I am not capable of, but if that helps you understand, then that is acceptable.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: I merely add one extra stop on the journey before the flesh is returned to dirt. Or the sewers in most cases.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I merely add one extra stop on the journey before the flesh is returned to dirt. Or the sewers in most cases.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Marius came to me, he wanted to donate his leg to the cause. He was quite insistent.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Marius came to me, he wanted to donate his leg to the cause. He was quite insistent.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Sadly that is an impossibility. Tell him the leg is long gone. Rotten inside a sewer I should think. He donated it years ago.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sadly that is an impossibility. Tell him the leg is long gone. Rotten inside a sewer I should think. He donated it years ago.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Well I couldn't be more clear. This is purely process over product. All calculations are kept completely private. Not for public consumption.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I couldn't be more clear. This is purely process over product. All calculations are kept completely private. Not for public consumption.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Oh absolutely. Thousands! Again though, just for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh absolutely. Thousands! Again though, just for me.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Oh try sequencing rat DNA and see how you like it? I can do a rat in about five minutes. Where is the fun in that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh try sequencing rat DNA and see how you like it? I can do a rat in about five minutes. Where is the fun in that?

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: I have no reason to lie. I can get flesh any time I choose.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have no reason to lie. I can get flesh any time I choose.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Please let Marius know that sadly his leg is gone and his records, such as they are, will remain private.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Please let Marius know that sadly his leg is gone and his records, such as they are, will remain private.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: You've seen the leader boards. Profits like these take a lot of work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You've seen the leader boards. Profits like these take a lot of work.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: I'm an android. I have no regular use for my bathroom.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm an android. I have no regular use for my bathroom.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Monitoring supply chains, margins, staff rotors. It's all quick maths. Those muscles need conditioning.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Monitoring supply chains, margins, staff rotors. It's all quick maths. Those muscles need conditioning.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Very handy if your suppliers exist mostly in theoretical space.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Very handy if your suppliers exist mostly in theoretical space.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: I'm sure you would.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sure you would.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What the...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What the...?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What the...?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What the...?

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: To keep my mathematics skills sharp, I have been raiding their bins for discarded human flesh.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: To keep my mathematics skills sharp, I have been raiding their bins for discarded human flesh.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Each persons DNA posses a very particular mathematics problem - millions of lines of human code just begging to be mapped.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Each persons DNA posses a very particular mathematics problem - millions of lines of human code just begging to be mapped.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sudoku won't do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sudoku won't do?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sudoku won't do?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sudoku won't do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It needs to be done.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It needs to be done.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It needs to be done.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It needs to be done.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Horses are fun but you never see them anymore.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Horses are fun but you never see them anymore.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There are no other options?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There are no other options?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: There are no other options?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: There are no other options?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Cats? Dogs? Pigs? Horses?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cats? Dogs? Pigs? Horses?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Cats? Dogs? Pigs? Horses?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Cats? Dogs? Pigs? Horses?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I've seen your name on the business leader boards, you're doing well.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've seen your name on the business leader boards, you're doing well.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I've seen your name on the business leader boards, you're doing well.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I've seen your name on the business leader boards, you're doing well.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure what that means?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure what that means?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not sure what that means?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not sure what that means?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds complicated.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds complicated.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That sounds complicated.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That sounds complicated.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I need to ask you about a leg.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need to ask you about a leg.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I need to ask you about a leg.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I need to ask you about a leg.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Someone you might know from the leader boards, Marius Mitchell, he said you borrowed his leg and didn't return it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Someone you might know from the leader boards, Marius Mitchell, he said you borrowed his leg and didn't return it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Someone you might know from the leader boards, Marius Mitchell, he said you borrowed his leg and didn't return it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Someone you might know from the leader boards, Marius Mitchell, he said you borrowed his leg and didn't return it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wow! How many legs have you borrowed?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wow! How many legs have you borrowed?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Wow! How many legs have you borrowed?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Wow! How many legs have you borrowed?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Audit?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Audit?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Audit?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Audit?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do I want to know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do I want to know?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do I want to know?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do I want to know?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What does that even mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What does that even mean?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What does that even mean?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What does that even mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Help me connect the dots here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Help me connect the dots here.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Help me connect the dots here.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Help me connect the dots here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So this is a hobby. Genome sequencing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So this is a hobby. Genome sequencing?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So this is a hobby. Genome sequencing?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So this is a hobby. Genome sequencing?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's disgusting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's disgusting.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's disgusting.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's disgusting.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I mean I guess it was already going to waste...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean I guess it was already going to waste...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I mean I guess it was already going to waste...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I mean I guess it was already going to waste...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So if you're raiding bins, how do you know Marius?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So if you're raiding bins, how do you know Marius?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So if you're raiding bins, how do you know Marius?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So if you're raiding bins, how do you know Marius?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think he was under the impression he might get it back...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think he was under the impression he might get it back...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think he was under the impression he might get it back...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think he was under the impression he might get it back...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe he wanted his genome mapping for some reason?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe he wanted his genome mapping for some reason?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe he wanted his genome mapping for some reason?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe he wanted his genome mapping for some reason?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But you do keep a record?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But you do keep a record?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But you do keep a record?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But you do keep a record?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have a bad feeling about this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have a bad feeling about this.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have a bad feeling about this.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have a bad feeling about this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds very dangerous.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds very dangerous.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That sounds very dangerous.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That sounds very dangerous.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Surely there are less intrusive ways to practice mathematics? Why human flesh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Surely there are less intrusive ways to practice mathematics? Why human flesh?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Surely there are less intrusive ways to practice mathematics? Why human flesh?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Surely there are less intrusive ways to practice mathematics? Why human flesh?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure I believe you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure I believe you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not sure I believe you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not sure I believe you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why is it so important to practice your maths?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why is it so important to practice your maths?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why is it so important to practice your maths?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why is it so important to practice your maths?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you steal people's discarded flesh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you steal people's discarded flesh?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you steal people's discarded flesh?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you steal people's discarded flesh?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You flush it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You flush it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You flush it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You flush it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How's that even possible?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How's that even possible?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How's that even possible?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How's that even possible?

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Just learn that it is. It's too high for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just learn that it is. It's too high for you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Huh?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Aaah!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aaah!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Aaah!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Aaah!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sure I would remember borrowing a leg..

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sure I would remember borrowing a leg..
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sure I would remember borrowing a leg..
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sure I would remember borrowing a leg..

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Don't tell me why...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't tell me why...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Don't tell me why...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Don't tell me why...
